correctness.rationale: Exact rational enumeration verifies sixteen unimodular cones and twelve nef anticanonical polytope vertices. Primitive degrees 0,0,2,2 prove nefness but not ampleness; lattice interior yields bigness. Character m=(1,1,1,1) gives half-anticanonical divisor, opposite rays prove maximal index2. Four glued cone pairs form two disjoint square circuits; toric star fans identify two P1xP1 exceptional surfaces mapping to P1, with ODP transverse singularity. Ehrhart counts 1,14,69,216,525 yield L^4=20 and -K fourth degree 320. Computational assertions checked with provided independent standard-library script; geometric part is a complete toric proof.
